📺 Parks and Recreation (2009–2015)

Parks and Recreation follows Leslie Knope, a passionate and optimistic government employee determined to make her hometown of Pawnee, Indiana, a better place. Working in the local Parks and Recreation Department, Leslie faces ridiculous political situations, demanding residents, and hilarious workplace challenges alongside her unforgettable coworkers. From Ron Swanson’s hatred of government bureaucracy to Andy Dwyer’s lovable stupidity and April Ludgate’s sarcastic personality, the team constantly finds itself in outrageous situations. Despite their differences, their friendships grow stronger as they navigate relationships, career ambitions, and unexpected adventures. Combining clever humor, heartfelt moments, and memorable characters, the series celebrates friendship, teamwork, ambition, and community.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Workplace Sitcom • Mockumentary

⭐ IMDb: 8.6/10

⏱️ Runtime: ~22 minutes per episode • 7 seasons • 125 episodes

🎥 Creators: Greg Daniels and Michael Schur

🏆 Awards: Winner of a Golden Globe Award for Amy Poehler’s performance and nominated for multiple Primetime Emmy Awards, including Outstanding Comedy Series.

📺 Where to Watch: Peacock • Amazon Prime Video and Apple TV (digital purchase). Availability varies by region.

source_details.synopsis: Parks and Recreation (also known as Parks and Rec) is an American political satire mockumentary television sitcom created by Greg Daniels and Michael Schur. The series aired on NBC from April 9, 2009, to February 24, 2015, for 125 episodes, over seven seasons. A special reunion episode aired on April 30, 2020. The series stars Amy Poehler as Leslie Knope, a perky mid-level bureaucrat in the Parks and Recreation Department of the fictional town of Pawnee, Indiana.
